mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`chat_group_invitation`(id, group_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, type, status, message, create_time, handle_time) values (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{message}, #{createTime}, #{handleTime})
mapper.select: select i.id, i.group_id, i.inviter_id, i.invitee_id, i.type, i.status, i.message, i.create_time, i.handle_time, g.name as group_name, g.avatar as group_avatar, u.username as inviter_name, u.avatar as inviter_avatar, (select count(*) from booknest.`chat_group_member` cm where cm.group_id = i.group_id) as member_count from booknest.`chat_group_invitation` i inner join booknest.`chat_group` g on g.id = i.group_id left join booknest.`user` u on u.id = i.inviter_id where i.invitee_id = #{inviteeId} and i.type = 'INVITE' and i.status = 'PENDING' order by i.create_time desc

select i.id, i.group_id, i.inviter_id, i.invitee_id, i.type, i.status, i.message, i.create_time, i.handle_time, g.name as group_name, g.avatar as group_avatar, u.username as invitee_name, u.avatar as invitee_avatar, (select count(*) from booknest.`chat_group_member` cm where cm.group_id = i.group_id) as member_count from booknest.`chat_group_invitation` i inner join booknest.`chat_group` g on g.id = i.group_id left join booknest.`user` u on u.id = i.invitee_id where i.group_id = #{groupId} and i.type = 'JOIN_REQUEST' and i.status = 'PENDING' order by i.create_time desc
select group_id from booknest.`chat_group_invitation` where invitee_id = #{inviteeId} and type = 'JOIN_REQUEST' and status = 'PENDING'
select count(*) from booknest.`chat_group_invitation` where group_id = #{groupId} and type = 'JOIN_REQUEST' and status = 'PENDING'
select count(*) from booknest.`chat_group_invitation` i inner join booknest.`chat_group` g on g.id = i.group_id where g.owner_id = #{userId} and i.type = 'JOIN_REQUEST' and i.status = 'PENDING'
